slug.description: URL identifier for the article (used in /help/:slug)

category.description: Optional grouping label shown on the Help index

summary.description: Short description shown on the Help index

body.description: Article content. Supports simple formatting and {{screenshot: Label | optional-url}} placeholders.

status.description: Only published articles are visible in the portal

required_feature.description: Optional RBAC feature key (e.g. events.browse-events, commerce.balances, user.about-me) the member must be able to access to see this article. Empty/unset means visible to everyone. Gating is presentation-only, mirroring portal navigation.
